caption: The drawing depicts a woven basket placed against a plain, light-colored background. The basket is oval-shaped with a broad, sturdy handle arching from one side to the other. The basket is primarily brown with varying tones indicating the natural texture and material of the weaving, and the surface shows intricate, tightly woven patterns. The handle is slightly darker and thicker, attached to the rim with overlapping strips. The rim of the basket is reinforced with uniform, neatly looped bands that add structure. Shadows beneath the basket and within its weave suggest depth and dimension. On the bottom right corner, small black text reads "SAMUEL GRANT DEL. 550-1".
title: Market Basket
